rankingPolicy.independentVerifiedSites: 5 per independent site, maximum 3; duplicate subdomains and same-seller pages count once; pending links and social posts do not contribute.
rankingPolicy.nearby: Up to 12 proximity points for nearby searches; geographic filters still determine eligibility.
rankingPolicy.ties: Verified source quality, deduplicated evidence, distance, name, id; deterministic.
